name: admin-proposals
title: admin-proposals
description: admin-proposals's view: The dashboard's side of the agent's changes to itself: the proposals that `proposals` holds (proposals-local on a server, proposals-github on Cloudflare) listed with their diff and checks, approved or rejected there by an operator; and a Settings section saying whether they can be made and approved now, with the deploys that follow. Its admin API routes come with the component (pikit add admin-proposals).
